user_story: As a community member watching a video or live stream, I want tapping the player surface to reveal controls rather than toggle pause, so that I don't accidentally interrupt playback during normal viewing.
preconditions: User is viewing a video post or live stream post on any scoped surface
entry_points: A. Video or live stream is playing inline in any feed (global, user, community, event discussion)
B. Video or live stream is open in a media gallery or fullscreen view
last_synced: 2026-07-08 (Jira updated 14:27 — AC-04 pause overlay expanded: play icon persists + back/forward seek indicators remain + tap-outside dismisses overlay (video stays paused); AC-02/AC-03 given now scoped 'while playing'; AC-05 narrowed to video, livestream resume → UC2; PM comment 68362: playing = 1s auto-dismiss, paused = play icon persists until tap-outside)

not_supported: Desktop — no behaviour change; only a small UI design change (button size), per PM Ghita 2026-07-06

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap playing player → controls overlay appears, playback continues
given: A video or live stream is playing
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps anywhere on the player surface
then: Playback continues uninterrupted — the video or stream does not pause

platform_variance.note: FIRST-TAP behaviour differs by form factor — test-case expected MUST be split per platform. This AC-01 (tap = reveal controls, playback continues) describes the MOBILE behaviour only.

mobile.expected: Tap anywhere on the player reveals the controls overlay; playback CONTINUES — the first tap does NOT pause. Pausing is a 2nd action (tap the central pause button). = AC-01 as written.

desktop.expected: 1-Step Pause — the first tap toggles pause/play directly (tap = pause). Tap-to-reveal is NOT applied on desktop (consistent with platforms.not_supported: 'Desktop — no behaviour change'). AC-01 'controls appear + playback continues' does NOT hold here.
desktop.source: PM/QA note 2026-07-08 + platform table (comment 68264: web-desktop pause ✅, web-mobile ❌)

platform_variance.test_design: Do NOT write one cross-platform expected for tap-interaction ACs. Cascades to how the paused state is entered (UC1 AC-04, UC2 pause entry). See qa/PDT-3418/platform-behavior-notes.md.

clarifications_needed.observation: Web, iOS and Android all use a DIFFERENT player component for a 'Live' live stream than for a video / recorded live stream (Jira comments Chayanit 68297, Prisa 68302, Fidriyanto 68318, 2026-07-07)
clarifications_needed.consequence: Tap-to-reveal verified on video/recorded LS does NOT automatically cover 'Live' LS — separate render path on every platform; must be implemented and tested separately
clarifications_needed.question: Confirm tap-to-reveal must work identically across video / recorded LS / 'Live' LS?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Confirmed all platforms (Jira 2026-07-07): 'Live' LS uses a separate component from video/recorded LS on web, iOS and Android. Test as two paths — (1) video + recorded LS, (2) 'Live' LS — on each platform. See ledger GAP-04.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap outside pause button while overlay visible → overlay dismisses, playback continues
given: The video or live stream is playing
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps anywhere on the player surface outside the central pause/play button

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-02 splits 'tap outside the central button' (dismiss) from tapping the button (pause) but does not define the button's hit-target size
clarifications_needed.consequence: A tap near the button edge resolves as button vs surface non-deterministically → pause vs dismiss becomes ambiguous
clarifications_needed.question: What is the central pause/play button's hit-target size / spec?
clarifications_needed.resolution: PM answer 'same size, refer from figma' is not a concrete spec — exact hit-target dimensions still needed from Design/Figma. Low severity, non-blocking. See ledger AMB-06 / FOLLOWUPS FU-2.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: No action after overlay appears (while playing) → overlay auto-dismisses after 1s
given: The video or live stream is playing
acceptance_criteria.when: The user takes no further action
then: The overlay auto-dismisses after a short timeout (1 second)

clarifications_needed.observation: PRD still carries a leftover '(confirm... assume 3s)' comment while the Jira AC states 1 second
clarifications_needed.consequence: Docs out of sync — a PRD reader assumes 3s; test expectations diverge
clarifications_needed.question: Confirm 1 second is final and clean up the PRD comment?
clarifications_needed.resolution: 1 second is final (Jira AC-03 + PM confirm). Removing the PRD 'assume 3s' comment is a low doc-hygiene follow-up (FU-1). See ledger CONF-06.

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-03 auto-dismisses after 'no further action for 1s'; whether interacting with a control (volume, scrubber) resets that timer was unspecified
clarifications_needed.consequence: If the timer does not reset, the overlay may vanish while the user is still using the controls
clarifications_needed.question: Does the 1s auto-dismiss timer reset when the user interacts with an overlay control?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Yes — all platforms agree the countdown holds/restarts on interaction (Jira 2026-07-07: web Chayanit 68297 'counting includes volume + scrubber, controls will not disappear while changing'; iOS Prisa 68302 'agree'; Android Fidriyanto 68318 'reset on every interaction'). Effective rule: the 1s idle countdown restarts after each control interaction. Recommend PM fold this into AC-03. See ledger GAP-03.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap pause while playing → pauses; play icon + seek indicators persist; tap-outside dismisses overlay but stays paused
given: A video or live stream is playing
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the pause button
then: The button icon switches from pause to play and remains visible
On a video or recorded live stream: the back and forward seeking (10s skip) controls remain visible. On a 'Live' live stream: NO seek controls are shown
Tapping anywhere outside the play button dismisses the overlay controls — the media remains paused

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-04 was scoped 'video or live stream' and required 'back and forward seeking' indicators to remain visible on pause — but UC3 AC-06 says seek/skip buttons are NOT shown on a live stream (internal contradiction)
clarifications_needed.consequence: A LIVE pause overlay would ambiguously show seek controls it should not have
clarifications_needed.question: On a LIVE stream pause overlay, should back/forward seeking controls be shown?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Decision 2026-07-08: back/forward seeking (10s skip) controls appear on VIDEO and RECORDED live stream ONLY; a 'Live' stream pause overlay has NO seek controls (consistent with UC3 AC-06). The 'back and forward seeking' wording was a copy from the video overlay. AC-04 then[2] corrected. NOTE: the Jira AC-04 text still carries the old wording → PM to align Jira (FU-5) or the next sync re-introduces it. See ledger CONF-08.

clarifications_needed.observation: PRD A1 offered pause via 'a central button zone OR a double-tap gesture'; every AC uses only the central button
clarifications_needed.consequence: If double-tap were still supported: many more test cases + disambiguation from the single-tap-to-reveal gesture
clarifications_needed.question: Has the double-tap gesture been descoped (central button only)?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Double-tap gesture descoped — pause is via the central button only (PM, 2026-07). See ledger AMB-03.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap play while a video is paused → resumes from exact position, icon changes
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the play button
then: Playback resumes from the exact position at which it was paused
The button icon switches from play to pause

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-05 (as of 2026-07-08) is scoped to VIDEO only; live-stream pause/resume is owned by UC2 (PDT-3563), where resume returns to the CURRENT LIVE MOMENT, not the paused position
clarifications_needed.consequence: Resume-from-exact-position applies to video/recorded only — do not apply it to a live stream
clarifications_needed.question: n/a — scope note
clarifications_needed.resolution: Split confirmed: video resume = exact paused position (UC1 AC-05); live resume = current live moment (UC2 AC-02, ledger CONF-07).

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Behaviour is identical across all in-scope surfaces
given: Any in-scope surface (global feed, user feed, community feed, event discussion feed, media gallery)
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the player surface
then: The behaviour described above is identical regardless of surface
